name: io.github.syuaibsyuaib/ssyubix-pixelart-mcp
description: MCP server (Python) for drawing pixel art and assembling 2D game tilesets. Built with MCP Python SDK v1.x, stdio transport. Provides 24 drawing and tileset tools and export metadata for Unity import.

drawing.note: Pixel-level drawing primitives: create/import canvas, set_pixel, draw_line, draw_rect, draw_circle, draw_polygon, flood_fill

canvas_management.note: Canvas utilities: clear, flip, duplicate, get_info, get_preview, delete, list

tileset_export.note: Create tileset, set_tile, export_tileset (PNG + JSON metadata), delete_tileset, list_tilesets
